description: This Java class 'AliasKeyManager' implements the X509KeyManager interface to customize SSL certificate alias selection by wrapping an existing key manager and specifying a particular alias for client authentication.

classes.name: AliasKeyManager
classes.description: A custom implementation of X509KeyManager that selects a specific certificate alias for SSL communications, wrapping an existing key manager.

methods.name: chooseClientAlias
methods.description: Overrides method to select the configured alias if available among the provided key types.

methods.name: chooseServerAlias
methods.description: Delegates server alias selection to the wrapped key manager.

methods.name: chooseServerAlias (overloaded)
methods.description: Alternative method to choose server alias with different parameter order, delegates to wrapped key manager.

methods.name: getCertificateChain
methods.description: Retrieves the certificate chain for the specified alias, with verbose logging.

methods.name: getClientAliases
methods.description: Retrieves aliases for client certificates based on key type and issuers.

methods.name: getPrivateKey
methods.description: Retrieves the private key for the specified alias, with verbose logging.

methods.name: getServerAliases
methods.description: Retrieves server aliases for specified key type and issuers.
